Rows and columns both come from core/features.txt. An empty column is a site that enforces nothing — a finding about the workspace, not about the drawing. Column tooltips carry the firing moment, which is inferred from directory convention: no machine-readable hook-trigger registry exists yet.

the routing chain, three levels deep

20 directories sit deeper than level 3 and are not drawn. They are reached by the same chain, one hop at a time — which is the point of the spine rather than a gap in it.

Every edge is read from a generated routing block — the same table an agent follows. Nothing here is drawn by hand, so a wrong edge is a wrong routing table, and fixing the picture means fixing the source. Parsed 84 of 84 blocks.

tracked bytes per directory

587 tracked files, 2438 KB, folded to two levels. The inventory is git ls-files and never a directory walk — which is what keeps .venv, Downloads/ and the trash out of a picture of the workspace, three directories that would otherwise dwarf everything real.

coverage parsed 84 of 84 routing blocks · none unparsed

scope the workspace repository. 25 repositories nested inside it are drawn as directories and no deeper: each is its own repository and will earn its own document.

what is inferred every edge above renders declared or generated data except the firing moment of a hook, which is inferred from directory convention. No machine-readable hook-trigger registry exists yet, and until it does this page marks those and claims nothing more.

how to change it edit the source, not this file: core/features.txt for the matrix, a directory's CONTEXT.md for the spine. Regenerated and committed by /roundup at every session close, so a stale picture is a bug in the close, not a fact of life.
